name: Glasshouse
author: E. T. Carter
description: A steel framed greenhouse wall seen at a slant at night, receding to the right: behind fogged panes, some milky and some run clear, rows of magenta and violet grow lights and small warm sodium lamps glow over a dark hedge of backlit plants. Condensation beads lens the room and drops slide down the glass, leaving clear trails, above a block knee wall and a wet path that mirrors the glow.

params.label: Fog
params.effect: How thick the condensation is: clear glass showing the room sharp, up to milky panes where the lights are soft halos.

params.label: Drips
params.effect: How many drops run down the panes, leaving clear trails.

params.label: Grow lights
params.effect: Brightness of the grow lights and sodium lamps inside.
